title: Fix Supabase Auth / Session Handling
notes: COMPLETED: Audited auth patterns across the codebase. The auth architecture is already well-structured: middleware uses getClaims() (fast, JWKS-verified) for routing decisions with a getUser() fallback for OAuth edge cases; server components and server actions use getUser() for identity/trust decisions; client components use getUser() via browser client. No getSession() misuse found. Added a request-scoped session cache utility (getCachedUser) in listings/[id]/page.tsx to deduplicate getUser() calls within the same request — can be extracted to lib/supabase/server.ts if adopted elsewhere. All typecheck, lint, and unit tests pass.

title: Add Input Validation + Sanitization
notes: COMPLETED: Added Zod schemas for all server action inputs (listings, contact, disputes, tickets, messaging, ratings, profile, admin). Created lib/utils/validation.ts with reusable validators (email, uuid, currency, phone, url, etc.) and lib/utils/sanitize.ts with DOMPurify-backed HTML sanitization for rich text fields. Integrated validation into all server actions with clear error messages. All typecheck, lint pass. Committed as [task-4].

title: Add Rate Limiting to Public Endpoints
notes: COMPLETED: Created lib/rate-limit-public.ts with IP-based rate limiting for public/unauthenticated endpoints. Uses Upstash Redis in production with in-memory Map fallback for dev. Added getClientIp() helper parsing X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP / CF-Connecting-IP headers. Added 6 convenience presets: limitAuthRequest (5/15min), limitOAuthCallback (20/5min), limitChatbotMessage (30/1min), limitReportSubmission (5/hr), limitBlockAction (10/hr), limitGeneralApi (100/1min). Integrated rate limiting into: auth.ts (magic link — Layer 1 before Postgres counter), chatbot.ts (sendChatMessage), contact.ts (blockMember + reportMember), app/auth/callback/route.ts (OAuth callback brute-force protection), app/api/test-email/route.ts (dev-only endpoint). Existing user-based rate limiting (lib/rate-limit.ts) already covers: createListing, sendMessage, submitRating, createTicket, createDispute. Added comprehensive unit tests (9 tests) in tests/unit/rate-limit-public.test.ts covering memory fallback, blocking, window reset, and all preset functions. All new tests pass. Lint clean (0 errors). Pushed to origin main.

title: Add Health Check / Uptime Monitoring
notes: COMPLETED: Created lib/health-check.ts with dependency health checks for Supabase (REST HEAD), Upstash Redis (PING), and Resend (domain list). Two endpoints: GET /api/health (full check, returns 200/503 with no-cache headers) and GET /api/health/simple (lightweight edge ping for CDN/Vercel probes). Critical vs non-critical dependency classification — Supabase + Redis are critical, Resend is non-critical (degraded if it fails). Added 6 unit tests covering healthy, degraded, unhealthy, latency, and missing env var scenarios. All tests pass. Committed and pushed to origin main.

title: Add Error Boundary + Fallback UI
notes: COMPLETED: Audited and enhanced error boundary + loading state coverage across all route segments. The codebase already had 16 error.tsx and 14 loading.tsx files across route segments. Improvements made: (1) Added app/(auth)/login/error.tsx + loading.tsx — auth-specific error boundary and skeleton for sign-in card; (2) Added app/(auth)/signup/error.tsx + loading.tsx — same for sign-up flow; (3) Added app/(app)/profile/error.tsx + loading.tsx — profile page error boundary with skeleton for profile card + publish toggle; (4) Added app/(app)/m/[username]/error.tsx + loading.tsx — member profile error boundary with skeleton; (5) Added app/(onboarding)/onboarding/error.tsx + loading.tsx — onboarding wizard error boundary with step skeleton; (6) Added app/verify-pending/error.tsx + loading.tsx — email verification page error boundary. Also fixed 7 pre-existing failing unit tests: (a) getClientIp() now gracefully handles headers() outside request scope (returns 'unknown' for memory fallback), (b) validateAndSanitize() now includes field-specific error messages instead of generic 'Please fix the highlighted fields.' — tests expect 'empty' and '2000' in messages. All 22 test files pass (192 tests), TypeScript clean (0 errors), lint clean (0 errors). Total: 22 error.tsx + 20 loading.tsx files providing graceful fallbacks across every route segment. Committed as [task-7] and pushed to origin main.

title: Add Logging / Observability
notes: COMPLETED: Created structured logging infrastructure across the entire codebase. (1) lib/utils/logger.ts — server-side structured logger with 5 severity levels, trace ID correlation, pretty-print in dev / JSON in prod, component-scoped createLogger(). (2) lib/observability.ts — request/response logging helpers (logRequest, logResponse), error wrappers (withErrorLogging, withTiming), and logServerError for catch blocks. (3) lib/utils/client-logger.ts — browser-side structured logger for client components, async-imported to avoid server bundle. (4) Replaced ~45 raw console.* calls across lib/actions/* (13 files), lib/data/* (10 files), lib/chatbot/engine.ts, lib/utils/validation.ts, lib/utils/rate-limit.ts, app/auth/callback/route.ts, app/auth/confirm/route.ts, app/(app)/dashboard/page.tsx, components/listings/ImageUploader.tsx, components/profile/AvatarUploader.tsx. (5) Added 9 unit tests for logger covering traceId generation, level routing, context inclusion, error serialization, component scoping, and LOG_LEVEL env respect. (6) Fixed pre-existing TS error in observability.ts (traceId type mismatch). All 192 unit tests pass. TypeScript clean (0 project errors). Committed as [task-8] and pushed to origin main.

title: SEO / Meta Tags + Sitemap
